{{Quote|Skiers closing in on us! I thought we'd ''wiped out'' all the Rebels you were sent here to ''contact'', your highness--|Imperial commander to Leia Organa|<ref name="pursuit" />}}
A '''tracking scope''' was a component installed in the cockpit of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[snow flyer]]s in use on [[Akuria II]]. They functioned in a similar way to [[Targeting computer/Legends|targeting computers]], identifying and tracking nearby targets. The tracking scope could distinguish details of the targets, allowing the user to tell the difference between, for instance, a [[power ski]] and a larger craft.<ref name="pursuit" />
